Help & FAQ

How do I activate my OPD token?

Get your OPD card stamped (mohar) at the department counter. The token becomes active only after the stamp.

Where is the lab?

The Blood Lab is on the Ground Floor, Lab Wing, Counter 3. Use Navigate for turn-by-turn directions.

Is treatment free under Ayushman Bharat?

Eligible patients are covered under the Ayushman Bharat scheme; covered services show as Free in the app.

How will I get my report?

You will get an app notification when the report is ready, and can download the PDF from My Reports.
